entity.summary: Kazakhstan-based centralized cryptocurrency exchange whose public trading surface remains available while its AFSA Digital Asset Trading Facility licence has been withdrawn by the participant.
entity.notes: The current first-party site remains online with sign-in, sign-up, wallet, and exchange calls to action and continues to describe Swiftex.io Limited as an AFSA-authorised FinTech Lab exchange operator. AFSA's current public register instead records licence AFSA-G-LA-2024-0003 as withdrawn by participant effective 2026-05-05. HEI therefore uses `limited`: the public exchange surface remains present, but the reviewed regulator no longer shows an active Digital Asset Trading Facility licence. No terminal shutdown is inferred.

events.title: AFSA trading-facility licence withdrawn by participant
events.description: AFSA records Swiftex.io Limited's Digital Asset Trading Facility licence as no longer active after participant withdrawal.
events.notes: The regulator records the licence as withdrawn by participant. HEI does not convert this regulatory change into a permanent service shutdown because the first-party exchange surface remains publicly available.

evidence.title: Swiftex cryptocurrency exchange
evidence.notes: Current first-party site remains online with account, wallet, and exchange actions and identifies Swiftex.io Limited as the operator, although its regulatory-authorisation wording is stale relative to the current AFSA register.

evidence.title: Swiftex.io Limited AFSA Digital Asset Trading Facility licence
evidence.notes: Official AFSA public register identifies Swiftex.io Limited and records licence AFSA-G-LA-2024-0003 for Operating a Digital Asset Trading Facility as withdrawn by participant effective 2026-05-05.
